detail.longDescription: I was pleased to contribute to TechRound's new article examining the privacy implications of Meta's AI agent, Muse. My concern goes beyond what these agents collect about their users. What about the people whose emails, messages and personal information are processed by someone else's AI agent—without their knowledge or consent? Privacy doesn't end with the account holder. https:// techround.co.uk/cybersecurity/ experts-comment-metas-muse-can-collect-31-types-of-personal-data-should-you-be-worried/ # Privacy # AIPrivacy # AIAgents # DataProtection # DigitalRights
